subject: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks
body:
--- Message 1: 2025-09-12 09:12 (Karthik Iyer) ---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Nina Patel <nina@edgescale.com>, sales@edgescale.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks

Hi Nina — great to meet on the call earlier. As promised, looping in our contracts and onboarding leads to kick off the MSA + Order Form intake. I attached the draft MSA you sent during the trial (EdgeScale_MSA_v1.pdf) and a blank Order Form Exhibit A.

High-level asks from our side to help legal triage before an initial redline:
- Confirm target data residency and whether EdgeScale requires specific residency for logs or backups (we default to us-west region but will support multi-region).
- Provide the seat/usage tier you expect to sign for (helps populate Exhibit A).
- Any procurement-specific PO/DocuSign flow or SOW dependencies we should know about.
- Security evidence asks: do you need SOC 2 Type II, encryption-at-rest certs, or specific audit windows?

Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute intake tomorrow (Mon) or early next week? If you prefer, our legal lead Kimberly can do an initial redline pass and we can surface a short list of negotiable vs non-negotiable items.

Attachments: EdgeScale_MSA_v1.pdf (incoming), OrderForm_ExhibitA.xlsx (blank)

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

--- Message 2: 2025-09-12 10:05 (Nina Patel, EdgeScale) ---
From: Nina Patel <nina@edgescale.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: EdgeScale Legal <legal@edgescale.com>, EdgeScale Sales <sales@edgescale.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks

Thanks Karthik — happy to get this rolling. Quick answers inline: 
- Data residency: Primary requirement is US only for customer data; backups can be multi-region but encrypted. We'll add a short RID (residency) note in the MSA but legal will confirm exact language.
- Expected commit: starting with a 50-seat pilot, then scale to 250 seats within 12 months — Exhibit A will need seat/consumption rows.
- Procurement: Our procurement team prefers a single DocuSign envelope; PO after signature is fine. No SOW for this deal.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II attestation required; we also ask for an overview of your encryption practices and key mgmt.

I attached the MSA you requested with a couple of comments from our counsel (EdgeScale_MSA_v1.pdf). Can we do the 30-min intake Monday 9/15 at 11am PT?

Regards,
Nina Patel
Head of Partnerships, EdgeScale
nina@edgescale.com

--- Message 3: 2025-09-12 11:28 (Kimberly Park to internal) ---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks

Karthik — forwarding Nina's note. I pulled the attached draft and made an initial pass. Key flags I want on the intake: 
1) Liability cap: their draft has a cap tied to 12 months' fees; recommend we hold to a per-orderform cap of 1x fees with carveouts for IP infringement.
2) Data residency: ask for explicit language that logs and telemetry are pseudonymized and backups may be outside US if encrypted.
3) Audit window: propose 2 audits/year, with one for compliance and one for security (vendor-run), require reasonable notice.
4) Indemnity: narrow to third-party IP only; push back on broad product liability.

Also flag their Service Levels — SLAs in Exhibit B are aggressive for initial pilot; propose a baseline SLO with credits capped and a path to stricter SLA upon Dedicated deployment.

I can join Monday 9/15 11am PT. Will prepare a 1-page intake memo and a redline checklist before the call.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--- Message 4: 2025-09-12 13:02 (Marissa Cole quick note) ---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks

Adding ops perspective: please confirm expected billing cadence (monthly vs annual), and whether seat overage rules exist. If they plan to spike to 250 in <90 days, we should predefine prorated billing tiers in Exhibit A. Also request customer contact for order confirmations to be listed.

I'll assemble an Exhibit A template with the 50-seat pilot row + projected 250-seat ramp for the 12-month forecast.

-Marissa
Principal, Contracting & Onboarding
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--- Message 5: 2025-09-13 15:04 (Karthik consolidated reply to all) ---
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Nina Patel <nina@edgescale.com>, EdgeScale Legal <legal@edgescale.com>, EdgeScale Sales <sales@edgescale.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeScale MSA & Order Form kickoff: intake + initial asks

Thanks all for the quick turnaround and for confirming 11am PT Monday (calendar invite sent). Before the intake, Kimberly and Marissa will produce a short intake memo and a redline prioritization list. To make the call efficient, Nina — could you (or legal@edgescale.com) confirm the following and drop into the Drive folder linked below by EOD Monday if possible:
- Confirm final PO process (DocuSign envelope + PO after signature) and primary billing contact (name/email).
- Clarify the residency requirement language they want in the MSA (US-only for customer data vs logs). If there's sample clause language they'd prefer, paste it in a comment on the PDF.
- Any non-negotiable terms from counsel (e.g., specific indemnity carveouts, export control language) so we can prioritize.

Attachments referenced: EdgeScale_MSA_v1.pdf (their draft with comments), OrderForm_ExhibitA.xlsx (blank).
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-edgescale-msas
DocuSign room: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ES-MSA-2025

Planned internal deliverables before the call (Mon 9/15 11am PT):
- Kimberly: 1-page intake memo (flags + negotiation positions)
- Marissa: Exhibit A draft with 50-seat pilot row and ramp to 250 seats
- Jonas: Technical-handback note for infra team on residency/backup requirements

If we get the sample clause and billing contact ahead of the call, we can share the first redline by EOD Tue. Thanks — looking forward to the intake.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

--- End of thread ---

References to quoted text preserved where appropriate (e.g., forwarding and inline replies). Attachments are summarized as filename stubs above.
